title: Chant cancel with the pawn input state fix (DPC 0.9.177-dev5): the game should cancel by itself
intro: Runs by itself on the test bench: takes the first Mage or Sorcerer pawn, casts each skill slot twice and presses the cancel button mid-chant through DPC's dev chant_test. The log gets the values the game's cancel check reads.

probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing '..tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.job: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and tostring(D.state.pawn_job) or ''
probes.sk_now: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pc=D and D.state.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: 1/3 Setting up: a still goblin ahead
2/3 chant_test: Mage / Sorcerer pawn casts each slot, cancel pressed mid-chant (2 rounds)
